files.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>3 Send Several Things</title>
  <style>
    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #141414;
    }
    canvas {
      display: block;
      touch-action: none; /* a finger on the canvas never scrolls the page */
    }
  </style>

  <!-- a laptop sends one empty tilt reading. this drops it before p5 sees it -->
  <script>window.addEventListener('deviceorientation', function (e) { if (e.beta === null) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }, true);</script>

  <!-- p5.js 2.x -->
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@2.2.3/lib/p5.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5.js-compatibility@0.2.0/src/preload.js"></script>

  <!-- p5-phone: the join tap, tilt and Share -->
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5-phone@1.16.0/dist/p5-phone.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="sketch.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
